# E0349: an orelse's fallback may itself be absent

orelse's fallback is what the lens uses when the field is absent, so the
fallback itself must always exist: a constant, or a field the source always
has. An optional field may be absent too.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a?: string
	b?: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	c: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		c: orelse(v0_0.a, v0_0.b)
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0349]: b is optional in 0.0, so it cannot be orelse's fallback: the fallback must always exist
 --> 1.0.thema:8:21
  |
8 |         c: orelse(v0_0.a, v0_0.b)
  |                           ^^^^
  |
```
